name: Stasher Silicone Sandwich Bag
description: Stasher 28 oz reusable sandwich bag. The brand states it is platinum food-grade silicone and free of lead, latex, BPA, BPS, and phthalates. The FAQ checked does not say PFAS-free.
features: Stasher's FAQ says the bags are platinum, food-grade silicone and meet FDA and EU food-safety standards.
The same FAQ says the products are free of lead, latex, BPA, BPS, and phthalates. It does not use the word PFAS.
The brand says the bags are safe for the dishwasher, microwave, freezer, and oven up to 425°F, and to keep the seal partly open when heating.
Amazon ASIN B01DZQT99I is a 28 oz sandwich bag. The listing repeats the platinum silicone line and the same free-of list.
labelNote: Platinum silicone is the brand's material claim. The FAQ checked here has no PFAS sentence. This directory has not tested the bag.
